name: videoclaw OpenClaw Adapter
description: OpenClaw adapter for the videoclaw canonical skill pack and CLI workflow

cliBinary.description: Path or name of the videoclaw CLI binary

notes: This adapter treats the repo skills/ directory as the canonical workflow source.
Install the Python CLI separately (uvx videoclaw --help or pip install videoclaw).
OpenClaw should load skill content from the bundled skills/ directory rather than duplicating prompts into the manifest.
